title: Unify collections storage and add a Show-scoped create-Scene endpoint

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0055 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-23 directive to advance the storage-unification and create-Scene node. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0055.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-23 user directive.

claims.statement: CHG-0050 recorded that the collections router read a module-singleton storage while the shows and production routers used the injected dataStorage, diverging whenever a test injected a different storage; CHG-0054 deferred AC-006 (a Show-scoped create-Scene endpoint) as entangled with that split.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/collections.ts before this change importing the module singleton, and CHG-0050 and CHG-0054 deferred unknowns.

claims.statement: The change converts the collections router to a factory that receives the injected storage, so a Show and its Scenes resolve through one storage; production behavior is unchanged because the default injected dataStorage is the same singleton.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/collections.ts createCollectionsRouter and server/src/index.ts mounting createCollectionsRouter(dataStorage).

claims.statement: A new Show-scoped endpoint POST /api/shows/:showId/scenes verifies the Show exists and creates a Scene bound to the Show (its channel is the Show) starting at revision 1, closing AC-006's server capability.

Governed discovery reordered the node: unifying the collections storage first is what makes a clean, testable create-Scene endpoint possible, because otherwise the endpoint would write to a different storage than the Show rundown reads.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-23 and the collections storage split from CHG-0050.

claims.statement: Routing collections through the injected storage and adding a Show-scoped create-Scene endpoint proves a Show and its Scenes resolve through one storage and a new Scene is created bound to the Show; wiring the Studio Scenes surface's New Scene control to this endpoint and the full opens-in-Editor browser flow are follow-ons.

Human review accepted CHG-0055: the collections router is a factory over the injected storage, so a Show and its Scenes resolve through one storage, and a Show-scoped POST /api/shows/:showId/scenes creates a Scene bound to the Show at revision 1 (AC-006 server capability). The Studio New Scene wiring and the opens-in-Editor browser flow stay deferred.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/collections.ts, server/src/index.ts, server/tests/unit/collectionsStorageUnify.test.ts, the passing full server suite under npm run check, and the CHG-0055 pull-request Constitution run (all eight jobs), and human acceptance on 2026-08-23.

claims.statement: Production behavior is unchanged because the default injected storage is the same singleton; the refactor only affects tests that inject a distinct storage and closes the CHG-0050 divergence.
claims.evidence: server/src/index.ts createApp dataStorage default and the full server suite.

claims.statement: The Studio Scenes surface still routes New Scene directly to the Editor without calling the create endpoint, so the browser-tier opens-in-Editor half of AC-006 remains deferred; issuing designer accounts through user management also remains deferred.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/ScenesView.vue New scene routes to the Editor, and server/src/auth/AuthService.ts issues only the owner.

successCriteria.statement: The collections routes serve and persist through the injected storage, so an injected Show's Scenes are listed rather than a module singleton's.
successCriteria.verification: Harness test seeds a collection in an injected storage and asserts GET /api/collections lists it.

successCriteria.statement: POST /api/shows/:showId/scenes creates a Show-bound Scene at revision 1 that appears in the Show's collections, and rejects an unknown Show with 404.
successCriteria.verification: Harness test creates a Scene and asserts channel, revision 1 and its presence, and asserts 404 for an unknown Show.

successCriteria.statement: No existing production or collections behavior regresses.
successCriteria.verification: The full server suite passes with the collections router as a factory over the injected storage.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0055 records the storage unification, the Show-scoped create-Scene endpoint, and the deferred Studio wiring and user management before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: The collections router is a factory over the injected storage and exposes POST /api/shows/:showId/scenes.
A focused test proves collections resolve through the injected storage and the create-Scene endpoint binds a Scene to the Show at revision 1; the full server suite passes.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint, type-check and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
